Hi Ben / Marissa —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Velocity is excited about the integration prototype we discussed (shared auth + embedded demos). We chatted internally and there is appetite to do a co-hosted "Integration Demo Day" for customers and a short partner playbook blog that walks customers through the joint setup.

High-level ask from our side: do you have a standard agenda and a one-pager for co-marketing commitments (email sends, webinar lift, social posts)? We can commit to a short customer invite list and a joint deck.

Can you share a tentative date range? We were thinking late April / early May windows.

Best,

Thanks Samantha — excited to run with this. Quick responses inline below and a few asks for your team.

- Dates: Redwood can support a partner demo on 2027-05-12 or 2027-05-19 (both Thursdays). 5pm ET / 2pm PT works best for our EMEA overlap.
- Agenda: attached a draft (velocity-demo-agenda.pdf) — it's a 45-minute format: 10m intros, 20m joint demo (two short walkthroughs), 10m customer Q&A, 5m CTA (trial / MAP offer).
- Co-marketing commitments: we propose 2 dedicated email sends (1 week + 2 days before), 2 social posts, and a joint blog post. I've attached a MAP (mutual action plan) template (redwood-velocity-co-marketing-MAP.xlsx).

Please confirm if the dates work and whether you want Redwood to own registration + follow-up email copy. If you prefer Velocity to own registration we can supply an embed link and co-branded deck.

Next steps: if 5/12 ok, can we lock it today? I'll route this to Laura to get marketing ops standing up the event page.

Cheers,
